Exponents & Powers

What You’ll Learn

Section titled “What You’ll Learn”

In this lesson you’ll learn what exponents mean, the rules for positive/negative/zero exponents, and how to use scientific notation for large/small numbers.

The Concept

Section titled “The Concept”

An exponent shows repeated multiplication: 43=4×4×4=644^3 = 4 \times 4 \times 4 = 6443=4×4×4=64

Rules:

  • a1=aa^1 = aa1=a
  • a0=1a^0 = 1a0=1 (any non-zero number to power 0)
  • a−n=1ana^{-n} = \frac{1}{a^n}a−n=an1​ (negative exponent = reciprocal)

Example:

2−3=123=182^{-3} = \frac{1}{2^3} = \frac{1}{8}2−3=231​=81​

Multiplying powers: am×an=am+na^m \times a^n = a^{m+n}am×an=am+n

Dividing: am÷an=am−na^m \div a^n = a^{m-n}am÷an=am−n

Power of a power: (am)n=am×n(a^m)^n = a^{m \times n}(am)n=am×n

Scientific notation: Write numbers as a×10ba \times 10^ba×10b where 1≤∣a∣<101 \leq |a| < 101≤∣a∣<10.

  • 4500=4.5×1034500 = 4.5 \times 10^34500=4.5×103
  • 0.00032=3.2×10−40.00032 = 3.2 \times 10^{-4}0.00032=3.2×10−4

Worked Example

Section titled “Worked Example”
34=3×3×3×3=8150=12−2=122=146×105=600,000\begin{aligned} 3^4 &= 3 \times 3 \times 3 \times 3 = 81 \\ 5^0 &= 1 \\ 2^{-2} &= \frac{1}{2^2} = \frac{1}{4} \\ 6 \times 10^5 &= 600{,}000 \end{aligned}34502−26×105​=3×3×3×3=81=1=221​=41​=600,000​

Simplify 43×424^3 \times 4^243×42:

43×42=43+2=45=10244^3 \times 4^2 = 4^{3+2} = 4^5 = 102443×42=43+2=45=1024

Real-World Application

Section titled “Real-World Application”

Exponents appear in growth (population doubles = ×2\times 2×2 each period), interest (compound = P×(1+r)tP \times (1 + r)^tP×(1+r)t), scientific measurements (3.2×10−43.2 \times 10^{-4}3.2×10−4 grams), or computing (2102^{10}210 bytes = 1 kilobyte). Understanding powers helps with large/small numbers and patterns.

You’ve Got This

Exponents are just “repeated multiplying” — positive = big numbers, negative = fractions, zero = 1. The rules are shortcuts for multiplying/dividing powers. Practice with small exponents and real examples (growth, measurements) — it becomes intuitive fast.
